name: BIS Triennial Survey FX turnover
rate_limits: None published. The BIS may limit or suspend an IP address at any time. One call returns the whole table (about 0.7 MB).
history_start: 1989 for the total; most currency and instrument splits from 1995 or 1998. Latest survey April 2025.
what_it_has: Average daily FX turnover in April of each survey year, by currency and by instrument (spot, outright forwards, NDFs, FX swaps, currency swaps, options), in USD millions, from dataflow WS_DER_OTC_TOV.
simple: Every three years central banks count how much currency trading happens in a month. This is that count: about 9.5 trillion US dollars a day in April 2025.
license_terms: BIS terms: "if the statistics are reproduced, the BIS must be cited in your publication or product as the source"; use "must not be potentially misleading, for example by implying endorsement or affiliation with the BIS"; in a commercial product their inclusion must "not result in any additional charge". The APIs are offered "as-is" and the BIS "reserves the right to limit or suspend any User's IP address access to the APIs at any time". https://data.bis.org/help/legal
quality_notes: Net-net basis (each trade counted once). Shares add to 200% because each trade has two currencies. Survey years only, so nothing between surveys. Fetched with no key (tested 2026-10-21): total 7,468 billion USD a day for 2022 and 9,510 billion for 2025.

relevance.reason: The standard measure of how big each currency's market is, which sets how much we could trade without moving prices.
